projects.title: Player Archetypes & Pitch Strategy
projects.summary: Season-specific player tags, chronological pitch-selection beliefs, realized location, prior weapon/threat state, supported value and mixed-strategy diagnostics are complete through Slice 6D. Entropy is available as a threshold-labeled aggregate research diagnostic, while threshold sensitivity blocks an entropy leaderboard and the absence of a batter response model blocks true exploitability, individual strategy advice and causal claims. All human-readable Slice reports, catcher-calling prework and the Arm Angle supporting repair are consolidated in docs/PLAYER_ARCHETYPES_PITCH_STRATEGY.md; builders now update machine-readable artifacts without recreating per-Slice Markdown files.
projects.next_step: Treat Slice 0–6D as complete. If this research continues, either expose only the aggregate threshold-labeled entropy/supported-deviation panels in the Lab, or open a separately scoped batter-response slice with chronological validation before using true exploitability language.

slices.label: Slice 0 · Prior-work and feature coverage audit
slices.deliverable: Inventory the old per-start 3×3 Stuff/Location grid and define season-player feature contracts for pitchers and batters
slices.verification: Audited 4,284,184 regular-season pitches and 1,099,489 PA across 2021–2026. Old 3×3 has 4,836 unique starts/375 pitchers but 95.7% of starts fall in Average Location cells, so it is retired as player identity. Raw pitch/release/location features support all six years; per-pitch Stuff+ is complete only in 2023–2026 (2021 37.1%, 2022 0%); batter swing-shape is supported from 2024, partial in 2023. Artifact, readable report, denominator/time-availability contracts and 2 dedicated tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 1 · Season feature warehouse
slices.deliverable: One immutable pitcher-season table and one batter-season table with repertoire, shape, command, discipline, contact and platoon dimensions
slices.verification: Built versioned 2021–2026 Parquets with 6,564 unique pitcher-season-role rows (4,891 eligible) and 4,384 unique batter-season rows (2,775 eligible); duplicate keys 0/0. Raw numerators and denominators, empirical-Bayes rates, qualified-reference year×role×throwing-hand or year×bat-side z-scores, sample reliability, SP/RP hybrid rows, 1,382 opener-like appearances, position-player pitching and pure-pitcher batting exclusions are retained. Season Plus and per-pitch Plus remain separate; no imputation, tags or same-season pre-pitch use. SHA-256 fingerprints and 3 dedicated tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 2 · Multi-label archetype challenger
slices.deliverable: Compare interpretable rule tags with soft clustering or mixture memberships; publish three to four supported tags rather than one forced identity
slices.verification: Rule prototypes and role-separated Gaussian mixtures were compared across 10 cohorts/dimensions with k=2–5 BIC selection, minimum cluster support and 30 player-cluster bootstraps. Outputs contain 26,256 pitcher tag rows and 17,536 batter tag rows; eligible tagged entities average 3.39/3.43 published tags. SP arsenal failed the model-level silhouette/stability gate and remains null; 951 eligible batter swing-shape rows remain unavailable rather than imputed. Three dedicated tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 2A · Transparent arsenal and Arm Slot tags
slices.deliverable: Add exact-pitch arsenal depth, concentration, primary-pair and handed Arm Slot tags without forcing another learned cluster
slices.verification: Official 2026 Arm Angle backfill added 184,493 exact-key values and raised coverage from 73.580% to 99.327% while preserving all 716,544 pitch rows; all 832 eligible 2026 pitcher-role rows now exceed 70% Arm Angle coverage. Slice 2A emits 26,256 unique entity-dimension rows: arsenal depth/concentration support all 4,891 eligible rows, primary pair and Arm Slot support 4,873. Paul Sewald resolves to Two-Pitch RP/FF-ST Primary Pair/RHP Sidearm, Seth Lugo to Versatile SP with 7.04 effective pitches, Trey Yesavage to RHP Overhand and Chris Sale to LHP Sidearm.

slices.label: Slice 3 · Cross-year stability, transitions and tag balance
slices.deliverable: Measure which tags persist, change with role/team/arsenal, or reflect one-season noise; publish a sortable player tag roster and year-by-role tag distribution tables
slices.verification: Generated 10,948 unique player-season-role roster rows, 883 distribution rows and 4,011 transition cells from 29,541 adjacent-season tag pairs. Arm Slot retains 81.2%, Arsenal Depth 69.0%, Command 69.9% and exact Primary Pair 52.1%; the latter remains monitor. Boundary changes affect 0.5–6.0% of Arsenal Depth rows and about 13% of Arm Slot rows at ±2 degrees. SP learned Arsenal remains research-only and is excluded from the roster. Pitcher and Batter Tag Labs expose dimension-aware 3–4 tag rosters, distribution filters, sample reliability, headshots and personal-page links through a non-admin read endpoint. After safely replaying a WAL left by a dead daily-update process, all 246 backend tests, UTF-8 and Nuxt typecheck passed.

slices.label: Slice 4 · Pitch-decision state warehouse
slices.deliverable: Chronological pre-pitch state with count, base/out, score, platoon, prior pitch/outcome, pitcher/batter tags, catcher, available arsenal and supported catcher/pair/H2H priors
slices.verification: Built player_archetype_slice4_decision_states_v1 with 4,268,301 regular-season pitch decisions across 2021–2026. Source-row reconciliation, unique decision keys, PA-safe previous-pitch boundaries, nonnegative prior counts, prior-map totals and prior-season tag-year checks all pass with zero errors. The warehouse separates target action and observed post-decision labels, exposes strictly prior pitcher/catcher/pair/H2H maps plus backoff/support levels, and carries 2022–2026 prior-season pitcher/batter tag coverage of 76.18–77.70%/80.53–84.23%. Fifteen relevant tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 5 · Bayesian belief updating
slices.deliverable: Hierarchical priors from archetypes with pitcher/batter-specific posterior updates from earlier observations only
slices.verification: Built player_archetype_slice5_belief_update_v1 with a frozen 2021–2024 train, 2025 first-half calibration/second-half validation and untouched 2026 test. The 710,253-row deterministic training sample fits converged 58/172-feature regularized context/tag models without player IDs or post-decision features. On 2026, prior tags improve log loss from 0.922221 to 0.902987; pitcher-only updating reaches 0.847472 and the selected hierarchical update reaches 0.846456, Brier 0.518562, Top-1 57.963%, Top-2 89.682%, macro recall 48.618% and ECE 1.100%. Catcher weight shrinks to 0; pitcher-catcher and H2H weights are 0.1. Conditional exact-pitch output reaches log loss 1.499513, Top-1 40.591% and Top-2 66.861%. Cold-start groups remain scored and rows below 100 are withheld from metric claims. Model, 713,853-row prediction Parquet, SHA-256 contract, report and four dedicated tests are complete.

slices.label: Slice 5A · Observed location and Meatball proxy
slices.deliverable: Add batter-relative horizontal/vertical location cells and a Savant-compatible middle-middle miss proxy without leaking post-pitch location into the frozen choice model
slices.verification: Generated 713,853 unique 2026 pitch rows with 100% Statcast zone, coordinate and batter-zone normalization coverage. Meatball% uses zone 5 first and coordinate middle thirds only as fallback: 51,138 pitches, 7.164%. Middle-Middle reconciles exactly to the Meatball numerator; the Yamamoto-McCann home-run pitch remains Inside-Middle/zone 11 rather than being labeled a miss from its result. Slice 5 was not retrained, true target miss remains unsupported; 14 targeted and all 261 backend tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 6A · Pitcher Weapon State
slices.deliverable: Build exact-pitch pregame baselines and strictly lagged same-outing Stuff+/Location+ readiness for every supported pitch candidate
slices.verification: Generated 3,910,760 candidate rows across all 713,853 2026 decisions and exactly one chosen row per decision. Candidate Stuff+/Location+ state coverage is 100%; future-count, duplicate and chosen-target mismatch audits are zero. The Yamamoto–McCann case shows the four-seam state below baseline while the chosen sinker remained available; observed target scores stay post-pitch only.

slices.label: Slice 6B · Batter Threat Surface
slices.deliverable: Estimate reliability-aware Hunt+, Contact+ and Damage+ by batter, pitcher hand, count tier, pitch family and batter-relative location with league fallback
slices.verification: Generated 231,105 rows from 2021–2025 only: 230,785 batter cells and 320 league fallback cells, with zero null metrics or time-scope errors. Among 2026 chosen pitches, 67.31% map to high-support batter contexts, 14.79% limited, 8.06% sparse and 9.84% league fallback. Twelve targeted and all 265 backend tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 6C · Supported strategy value
slices.deliverable: Apply overlap and propensity gates before comparing observed strategy value or supported alternatives
slices.verification: Built a pre-pitch HistGradientBoosting value challenger with 2025 first-half development, 2025 second-half validation and untouched 2026 evaluation. All 3,910,760 candidate rows across 713,853 decisions score successfully; at the 2.5% propensity, 20-pitch weapon and 30-pitch threat gates, 582,185 decisions (81.56%) have at least two supported choices and 556,315 observed choices (77.93%) are supported. Validation RMSE is 0.228234 versus 0.228442 threat-only; 2026 RMSE is 0.224830 versus 0.225102. Effective sample size remains 347,572–507,134 across default-threshold weight caps, but the 90% single-pitch half-width is 0.294617 runs and zero alternative intervals separate, so only aggregate observational analysis is released; individual best-pitch and causal claims remain disabled. Four dedicated Slice 6C tests and eight Slice 6A–6C targeted tests passed.

slices.label: Slice 6D · Game-theory diagnostics
slices.deliverable: Report mixed-strategy entropy, supported deviations and exploitability sensitivity without factual-best-pitch claims
slices.verification: Verified the frozen Slice 6C SHA-256 before generating 2,303,246 unique threshold×decision diagnostics over four propensity gates. At the 2.5% gate, 582,185 decisions average normalized entropy 0.8571, 3.497 effective supported choices, 46.83% top-choice probability and 0.003188 runs/pitch one-sided supported deviation; zero deviations exceed the 0.294617-run single-pitch noise floor. Pitcher-cluster 90% intervals cover Overall, role, count-tier and platoon panels with no default subgroup below 500 decisions. Entropy changes by as much as 0.1051 across gates in BatterAhead counts, so an entropy leaderboard is withheld; deviation sensitivity is smaller at 0.000634. The Yamamoto–McCann case has 0.9271 normalized entropy and 5.265 effective choices, while the modeled SI-versus-FS gap remains far inside uncertainty. Aggregate diagnostics are research-ready, but true exploitability, individual advice and causal/factual-best claims remain disabled. Four dedicated Slice 6D tests and eight Slice 6C–6D targeted tests passed.

projects.title: Catcher Descriptive Metrics

The reconciled 2021–2026 ledger, c/t rates, cSaveRun reliability, Petehub xERA v1 and Statcast FRV defense axis are released with explicit association limits. The audit found and fixed a real deep-link defect where ?year=2026 was ignored in favor of 2021. Targeted backend tests, UTF-8 and Nuxt typecheck pass.

slices.label: Slice 8 · Optional strategy bridge
slices.deliverable: Place validated catcher descriptive results beside frozen model-consistent calling and predictability measures as separate axes
slices.verification: Built catcher_descriptive_slice8_strategy_bridge_v1 from fingerprint-verified frozen Slice 6C/6D artifacts without refitting. It reconciles 713,853 total 2026 decisions and 582,185 default-threshold supported-set decisions across 111 catcher contexts; 103 have at least 500 supported decisions and 8 are limited. Catcher Lab shows normalized entropy, effective supported choices, top-choice probability, supported deviation, model-minimum-choice rate, support coverage and four count-tier splits. Other seasons return unavailable without imputation. Release gates explicitly disable a leaderboard, composite score, individual pitch advice and causal caller attribution; no deviation clears the single-pitch noise floor. Dedicated and regression tests, authenticated browser audit, UTF-8 and Nuxt typecheck pass.
